Commentary: Matthew Forde to Shreyas Iyer, SIX, third six of the over. Shreyas Iyer just a hit away now. It's a short of length delivery just outside off, he gets forward and muscles the pull, long-on was in business but as he ran to his right, he watches it sail over. This is some exhibition of batting. 24 off the over and India are almost there. And Shreyas is definitely going for that 100. Don't doubt that ever
Roston Chase to Ishan Kishan, no run, drifting into the pads from round the wicket, Ishan Kishan wants to give Iyer the strike but fails to connect the flick
Roston Chase to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, wrists this to long-on and eases to the other end. Iyer is back on strike and is five away from his hundred

Roston Chase to Shreyas Iyer, SIX, maiden T20I hundred for India's T20I captain, Shreyas Iyer! Fastest by an Indian player against West Indies! This is ruthless. This is class. This is Shreyas Iyer at his very best. Tossed up by Chase, and Iyer simply hammers it over long-on for a towering six to reach the landmark. The last time he played a T20 at this venue, turning out for Punjab Kings, he smashed a hundred then too, and he has done it again tonight off just 42 deliveries, this time in India colours. He raises his bat and soaks in the applause from everyone inside the venue

Roston Chase to Shreyas Iyer, 1 run, oh Chase fires a needless throw and the game is over! Yorker on the stumps, dug out to the right of the bowler. Definite dot but Chase lets his frustration out and fires a throw when there is no back up. Ishan wasn't overly backing up and the off-target throw eventually ends the game
